title: Reference Guides: Technical Description and Information-Oriented Documentation
summary: Diataxis reference-guide principles: neutral, austere description of a product's structure (APIs, functions), mirroring the codebase, illustrated with examples rather than explained.
when-to-read: Read when producing or judging an authoritative technical description of a system's structure, API, or behavior. Do not read for task-oriented instructions on getting something done (see how-to-guides), or for material meant to build conceptual understanding of why the system works the way it does (see explanation).
